items.title: Why Google Discover Is No Longer Just For Publishers
items.summary: Google Discover is evolving beyond traditional publishers, now prominently featuring e-commerce sites, blogs, and personal sites. This shift broadens AEO opportunities for diverse content creators. Marketers should focus on engaging, timely content to capitalize on this expansion.

items.title: March 2026 Google Webmaster Report
items.summary: The March 2026 Google Webmaster Report summarizes key SEO developments, including the ongoing effects of the Discover Core Update and other algorithm tweaks. It highlights trends in search volatility and best practices for recovery. Webmasters are advised to focus on core quality signals.

items.title: Google's Titans And MIRAS: Significant Advancement In Long Context AI
items.summary: Google unveiled Titans and MIRAS, new models advancing long-context understanding in AI, with implications for search processing. These developments could reshape how AI handles complex queries in search results. SEO experts anticipate impacts on content depth and relevance requirements.

items.title: Supreme Court Denies Cert in AI-Generated Image Copyright Case
items.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court declined to hear Stephen Thaler's appeal regarding copyright registration for an AI-generated image, upholding lower court decisions that require human authorship for protection. This ruling solidifies barriers for AI-created works in publishing and art. The decision was announced on March 2, 2026.

items.title: Ars Technica Fires AI Reporter Over Fabricated Quotes Scandal
items.summary: Ars Technica terminated senior AI reporter Benj Edwards after retracting an article with fabricated quotes generated by AI tools. The controversy underscores accountability issues in AI-assisted journalism and editing processes. The incident surfaced around March 3, 2026.

items.title: Publishers Weekly Book Deals: Week of March 2, 2026
items.summary: Key deals include Chad Harbach's sophomore novel The Brightness to Little, Brown, Erica Bauermeister's thriller Jayne to Park Row, and Heather Gay's five-book Bad Mormons series to Podium. These announcements reflect robust activity in traditional fiction and thriller markets. Reported around March 1-2, 2026.

items.title: New Horror Releases Highlight March 2026 Lineup
items.summary: Reactor spotlights titles like Kirsten Kaschock's An Impossibility of Crows, a tale of obsessive crow-breeding and family trauma, and Jacquie Walters' Turn Off the Light, a time-spanning ghost story. These debuts and genre works signal strong horror publishing momentum. Article published March 4, 2026.

items.title: Sarah J. Maas Announces ACOTAR Books 6 and 7, Ignites BookTok
items.summary: On the Call Her Daddy podcast, Sarah J. Maas revealed two new A Court of Thorns and Roses books, with Book 6 eyed for October 2026, sending BookTok into a frenzy. The announcement underscores BookTok's power in driving fantasy series hype and sales. News broke March 5, 2026.

items.title: Scary Movie 6 Trailer Sparks Backlash Over Pronoun Joke
items.summary: The trailer for Scary Movie 6, released in early March, features a parody joke where a character corrects pronouns before being stabbed, prompting criticism from some viewers who called it transphobic and outdated. Others praised the film's return to irreverent satire mocking cancel culture and modern trends. Marlon Wayans defended the humor, stating it aims to make everyone laugh, including sensitive audiences.

items.title: Anna Camp Apologizes for Sharing Scream 7 'Boycott Didn't Work' Post
items.summary: Scream 7 star Anna Camp shared a post celebrating the film's box office success despite boycott calls from pro-Palestine activists protesting the firing of Melissa Barrera over her social media posts. The post drew backlash, leading Camp to apologize amid online outrage. The movie achieved record franchise openings, highlighting the boycott's failure.

items.title: British TV Journalists of Color Report DEI Backlash in Newsrooms
items.summary: A study reveals British TV journalists of color facing resentment from white colleagues over DEI initiatives post-2020 BLM, with many perceiving them as unearned advantages and 'woke culture' lowering standards. Interviewees described 'apartheid newsrooms' and weekly mockery of diversity efforts at BBC, ITV, and Sky. The report calls for stronger leadership to combat racism and improve DEI implementation.

items.title: Amazing Race Contestants Jonathan and Ana Towns File $8M Defamation Lawsuit
items.summary: Contestants from The Amazing Race have sued Paramount, CBS, Disney, and Jerry Bruckheimer Films for $8 million over alleged defamation from their portrayal on the show. The couple claims the depiction damaged their reputation. The lawsuit emerged in early March amid ongoing reality TV scrutiny.

items.title: Heated Rivalry Wins Outstanding New TV Series at GLAAD Media Awards
items.summary: Heated Rivalry took home the GLAAD Media Award for Outstanding New TV Series, alongside winners like Stranger Things. The hockey-themed queer drama has previously faced criticism from figures like Jordan Firstman over its portrayal of gay intimacy. The win comes amid ongoing fan debates on representation.

items.title: The Boys Releases Final Season Trailer
items.summary: Prime Video dropped the final trailer for the fifth and last season of The Boys, building hype one month before premiere. The teaser promises intense action and satire as the anti-superhero series concludes. Fans expressed excitement and emotion over the announcement.

items.title: Rowan Launches AI-Powered Platform to Address Small Business Succession Crisis
items.summary: Rowan is a new AI-powered succession platform designed to help small business owners prepare for successful transitions by organizing financial data, modernizing operations, and improving cash flow. It combines expert guidance with proprietary AI tools like the Collect Agent for accounts receivable automation, resulting in impacts such as boosting a sale valuation by $3.8 million and recovering over $300,000 in receivables in one month. The platform positions businesses to attract the right buyers and reduce owner dependence.

items.title: Introducing AI-Powered Creativity in CorelDRAW Graphics Suite 2026
items.summary: CorelDRAW Graphics Suite 2026 introduces AI-powered tools like image generation from text or images, AI Remix using Nano Banana for transforming photos and mockups, and one-click background removal to streamline workflows for designers and small creative businesses. Features in Corel PHOTO-PAINT include precise AI subject selection and masking for faster editing. Available via subscription, these tools enhance productivity while offering user control through AI credits.

items.title: 30+ Best AI Tools & Resources of 2026
items.summary: Rightworks highlights practical AI tools for small businesses in accounting and tax, such as Spark AI for tax navigation, Vic.ai for accounts payable automation, and 1040SCAN for tax workpaper organization. Dext Prepare handles expense management from receipts, and Docyt provides real-time reconciliation. These tools focus on time-saving automation and efficiency for SMB financial operations.
